name: questlock
description: Apply checked text revisions, reuse exact results, and run bounded local model tasks through a durable local broker.

interface.longDescription: Apply exact text replacements with source hashes and checks, reuse valid task results, or run bounded text tasks through a configured local model. Questlock stores results in a private local broker and reports measured usage. This desktop plugin runs a local MCP server. Paid fallback is disabled; model tasks require an explicitly configured local model. It does not discover files, edit workspace files, or execute commands through its MCP tools.
defaultPrompt: Run Questlock's first checked revision and repeat it to verify exact reuse without calling a model.
Use Questlock to apply the exact replacements I specify, with source and output checks.
Use my configured local model for a bounded summary of the snapshot I provide.
